project.title: Db2 Sentinel AI: Autonomous Financial Crime Surveillance, Multi-Agent AML & Regulatory SAR Intelligence Platform
project.short_description: Enterprise-grade multi-agent financial intelligence and anti-money laundering (AML) platform powered by IBM Db2 12.1+ native vector search, transactional state checkpointers, recursive CTE circular routing analytics, and automated FinCEN/RBI Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) generation.
project.category: AI / Financial Crime / Multi-Agent / Regulatory Compliance

ibm_db2.edition: IBM Db2 12.1.2+ (Community Edition Docker & Enterprise) with Dual-Mode Local Emulation
features_used: Native VECTOR(384, FLOAT32) column & VECTOR_DISTANCE(..., 'COSINE') for AML typology matching
Recursive Common Table Expressions (WITH RECURSIVE CTE) for multi-hop circular fund routing detection
Window Functions (AVG, SUM, RANK OVER PARTITION) for rolling 24-hour velocity anomaly scoring
JSON Metadata & SQL/JSON querying for unstructured transaction memo parsing
ACID Transactional Checkpoint Persistence for LangGraph agent workflows
Immutable Temporal Audit Trails for regulatory compliance and audit logs

ai_models: Ollama granite3.3:8b / OpenAI GPT-4o / Google Gemini
